<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Let me try clicking the bottom green entity at (35,48)
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 35, 'col': 48}])
print("Bottom green click:", result.get('board_changed'), result.get('gameplay_changed'), result.get('level_completed'))

# Check what changed
before_seg = previous_frame.segmentation
after_seg = current_frame.segmentation

before_blocks = {}
for n in before_seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] == 4 and n['color'] not in ['B', 'c', 'G', 'N', 'R']:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        center_r = sum(rows) // len(rows)
        center_c = sum(cols) // len(cols)
        before_blocks[(center_r, center_c)] = n['color']

after_blocks = {}
for n in after_seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] == 4 and n['color'] not in ['B', 'c', 'G', 'N', 'R']:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        center_r = sum(rows) // len(rows)
        center_c = sum(cols) // len(cols)
        after_blocks[(center_r, center_c)] = n['color']

changes = []
for pos in set(list(before_blocks.keys()) + list(after_blocks.keys())):
    bc = before_blocks.get(pos, '?')
    ac = after_blocks.get(pos, '?')
    if bc != ac:
        changes.append((pos, bc, ac))

print(f"Changed blocks ({len(changes)}):")
for pos, bc, ac in sorted(changes):
    print(f"  {pos}: {bc} -> {ac}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
